decisions.reason: As a chemical manufacturer, the firm is likely to see this consumer superfood drink as a weak strategic fit with limited option value, and a mere website mention suggests low commitment.

These modular waste-to-energy extensions are closer to the firm's industrial capabilities, and after only one year it is still worthwhile to keep the option open while market feedback remains limited.
A dedicated product page signals relatively strong commitment, and the waste-oil-to-energy offering fits the firm's process and energy-related know-how well enough to justify continued observation.
Plastic-waste-to-fuel is strategically adjacent and potentially valuable, so despite high uncertainty the firm would likely retain it for another year rather than abandon the option too early.
